answer.summary: API Types Check failed because the generated TypeScript API types differ from the committed api-types.d.ts (the log shows added fields such as last_verified_at and has_more). The PR changed the backend API without regenerating types. This is deterministic, so a re-run will fail again. Fix: run yarn generate-types-from-api and commit the updated api-types.d.ts.

evidence.quote: ⚠️ Forgot to generate types! Please run 'yarn run generate-types-from-api' before committing.
